name: Richard Nugent
bio: A Representative from Florida; born in Evergreen Park, Cook County, Illinois, on May 26, 1951; B.A., Saint Leo College, Saint Leo, Fla., 1990; M.P.A., Troy State University, Troy, Ala., 1995; Illinois Air National Guard, 1969-1975; deputy sheriff, Hernando County, Fla.; sheriff of Hernando County, Fla., 2000-2010; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Twelfth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2011-January 3, 2017); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Fifteenth Congress in 2016.
